note: Realistic filled-in states in the engine's shape. `expected` is computed by `bin/test-personas --update` and verified by `bin/test-personas`. This is an acknowledgement-only form: `grade` is a three-check completeness validator (box ticked, name present, date present) returning `overallStatus` complete/incomplete plus one fired rule per missing item; there is no severity axis and no separate flags module. The practice-configuration section (practice name, DPO, sharing partners) is notice content only and is never graded.

personas.name: complete-acknowledged-signed-dated
personas.description: The patient has read the notice, ticked the acknowledgement box, and given their name and the date — expect overallStatus complete with no fired rules.

personas.name: incomplete-nothing-acknowledged
personas.description: The notice was opened (practice details configured) but the acknowledgement step was never completed — box unticked, name and date blank, with the date field holding whitespace only, which the trim-based check correctly treats as blank — expect overallStatus incomplete with all three rules fired.
